name: whispr
description: Your whispr meeting graph in Claude Code: the read-only graph tools (whispr-kg), task review (whispr-tasks, /create-tasks), the /whispr-graph pane, open alerts at session start, and /whispr-setup

python.title: whispr Python
python.description: The python.exe of your whispr install: <install>\python\python.exe for the installed distribution, <repo>\.venv\Scripts\python.exe for a checkout. Every server, hook and pane of this plugin runs it, never the python on PATH. The installer prints the value.

whispr_root.title: whispr folder
whispr_root.description: The folder holding whispr's pipeline\, kg\ and config\: your install folder, or the repo checkout. The installer prints the value.

config.title: Config overlay
config.description: A per-user config overlay file. Empty: whispr's default, %APPDATA%\whispr\config.yaml (the one /whispr-setup writes).

graph_max_hops.title: Graph pane: most hops offered
graph_max_hops.description: The /whispr-graph hops picker offers 1 to this many. kg.view cuts a larger request to kg.traverse.max_hops, so match that.

graph_timeout_s.title: Graph pane: read timeout (s)
graph_timeout_s.description: How long one graph read (python -m kg.view) may take before the pane reports it as failed.
